role: frequency-ordered word list (full list; the app bundles its head as the seed)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang be --script cyrillic --stop "tom,mary,john,jim,mike,ken,sami,layla,jane,bill,bob,jack,maria,mari,том,тома,тому,томам,мэры,марыя,джон,джона" --out be_words.txt bel_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: lowercased; tokens of the language's script letters plus an internal apostrophe / Catalan middle dot; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen fewer than 3 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the top 900 lines as its seed and downloads this full list on the user's request.
